PROJECT_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: A project groups the inboxes that belong to one product or brand, so agents can narrow Live chats to just that project instead of every inbox at once.

LIST.404: There are no projects yet. Add one to group your inboxes.

FORM.DESC: Name the project and pick the inboxes that belong to it.

LOGO.LABEL: Logo
LOGO.HELP: Shown next to the project in the sidebar. A square image works best.

INBOXES.LABEL: Inboxes
INBOXES.HELP: An inbox can belong to one project. Unticking an inbox leaves it without a project.
INBOXES.EMPTY: There are no inboxes in this account yet.
